heading: Positions at level V

(100)–(116)5 U.S.C. 2211(g).Aug. 14, 1964, Pub. L. 88–426, § 303(g), 78 Stat. 422. Paragraphs (100)–(116) are added on authority of former section 2211(g) which authorized the President to place, from Aug. 15, 1964, to Feb. 1, 1965, not more than 30 positions in Levels IV and V of the Federal Executive Salary Schedule. Pursuant to this authority, the President by Executive Order No. 11189, Nov. 23, 1964, as amended by Executive Order No. 11195, Jan. 30, 1965, placed the positions listed in paragraphs (100)–(116) in Level V. Standard changes are made to conform with the definitions applicable and the style of this title as outlined in the preface to the report.
